messages:
Sam Warren: Heads-up: scheduling GitHub SSO + service-account token cutover this Tue 09:00 PT. This migration replaces long-lived PATs with short-lived OIDC tokens for CI runners. Read the runbook and flag blockers: https://runbook.internal/redwood/sso-oidc-cutover :sparkles:
Jess Li: Quick q — blast radius? Will self-hosted runners start failing if we don't update right away?
Sam Warren: Short answer: not immediate catastrophic failure. Existing PATs will remain valid for a 48h grace after cutover. Repos with PATs in repo secrets will see CI failures once tokens are revoked. Self-hosted runners that rely on org-level tokens need updated config before the window closes.
Maria Gomez: What about the automation that opens Jira tickets from CI?
Sam Warren: If that automation uses a GitHub App, it's fine. If it calls GH APIs directly with a PAT (e.g., curl to api.github.com), it needs to switch to an OIDC workflow or use the new `ci-service` service account. Runbook section "migrations/jira-and-automation" has sample changes.
Noah Patel: For Redwood Dedicated customers — any special rotation steps to avoid expired creds during maintenance windows?
Sam Warren: Yes, Dedicated section in runbook. Dedicated nodes should fetch tokens via our KMS-backed secrets agent; rotation is automated via `infra/sa-rotation`. If you manage on-prem runners, coordinate with infra before Tue.
A J: I'm coordinating a preflight Monday 16:00 PT on a small set of repos (dev, playground, internal-sdk). Need volunteers to watch logs and triage failures. :eyes:
Jess Li: I'll watch. Can someone paste the exact test command to exercise the OIDC exchange?
Sam Warren: Example test (run on a runner machine):
```
# request token via OIDC (example)
curl -X POST \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"audience":"https://token.redwood.ai","repository":"redwood/internal-sdk"}' \\
  https://sts.internal.redwood/get-oidc-token
```
Sam Warren: Also run `gh auth status` and ensure `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true` in the environment when testing.
Deploy Bot: deployment #lib-runner-config v1.14.2 started by A J (CI-runner updates). Status: in_progress
A J: Preflight invite posted in #eng-platform. If you have scripts referencing `GH_TOKEN` or `GITHUB_PAT`, please search repos and open PRs to replace with OIDC or the `ci-service` account.
Maria Gomez: I'll audit `automation/issue-bot` and post a list of changes by EOD.
Noah Patel: If a repo can't migrate in time, can we get a short extension?
Sam Warren: We can grant short extensions case-by-case. File a help ticket with repo name and owner. Aim is minimal tail risk, but we will be pragmatic.
Jess Li: Thanks — see you Monday 16:00 PT. :thumbsup:
Sam Warren: Final checklist + preflight invite will be posted in ~2 hours.
